اشترفنا (form VIII)
# اِشْتَرَفْنَا (ištarafnā) /iʃ.ta.raf.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِشْتَرَفَ (ištarafa)
# اُشْتُرِفْنَا (ušturifnā) /uʃ.tu.rif.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِشْتَرَفَ (ištarafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
